info.title: Device_Profile
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

cdp_groups.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_CDP_Group](#/Port_Access_CDP_Group)
Administrator can specify the CDP group to use for matching criteria. CDP TLVs advertise sysgroup, sysdescr, chassis_id etc., to indicate the device type. The CDP group allows grouping based on such criteria and specifying that CDP group here, links the role assignment accordingly.

lldp_groups.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_LLDP_Group](#/Port_Access_LLDP_Group)
Administrator can specify the LLDP group to use for matching criteria. LLDP TLVs advertise sysgroup, sysdescr, chassis_id etc., to indicate the device type. The LLDP group allows grouping based on such criteria and specifying that LLDP group here, links the role assignment accordingly.

mac_groups.description:
Reference Resource: [MAC_Group](#/MAC_Group)
Administrator can specify the MAC group to use for matching criteria. MAC signature can be specified via OUI/mask or complete MAC address.

name.description:
Reference Resource: [Device_Profile](#/Device_Profile)
The name of the profile.

role.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Role](#/Port_Access_Role)
Role to be applied when a device is identified based on LLDP match criteria specified in this profile.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
